title: BravesVision Top 10 2026
description:
Nationals at Braves, 5/22/26
Bryce Elder's eighth quality start drops his ERA to 1.97, then CJ Abrams twice puts Washington ahead; Chadwick Tromp answers with a two-out single in the 11th, the first walk-off hit of his career, for a 5-4 Braves win.

title: Celebrating '95
description: Steve Avery blanks the Marlins for nine innings, and the game is still scoreless in the bottom of the ninth when pinch-hitter Dwight Smith launches a two-out walk-off grand slam.

title: Celebrating '95
description: Back-to-back walk-offs at Fulton County; a night after Dwight Smith's slam, rookie Chipper Jones drills the first walk-off homer of his career, a ninth-inning solo shot off Robb Nen, to beat the Marlins 8-7.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
October 23
NLCS Game 6. Eddie Rosario's three-run homer off Walker Buehler puts Atlanta ahead, then Tyler Matzek strikes out Pujols, Souza and Betts with the tying runs in scoring position. Braves win 4-2 for their first pennant since 1999.

title: 10 Best BravesVision Games of 2026
description:
#10 Brewers at Braves
Chris Sale and Kyle Harrison trade zeros until Ozzie Albies leads off the fifth with a solo homer, then ends it in the ninth with a two-run walk-off drive off Aaron Ashby, handing the Brewers' lefty his first loss after 10 wins. Braves win, 4-3.

title: 2018 Cooperstown Roundtable
description: Atlanta Braves Hall of Fame members Chipper Jones, Greg Maddux, Tom Glavine, John Smoltz, Bobby Cox and John Schuerholz get together during the Hall of Fame induction weekend for Chipper Jones.

title: 3 Aces: Glavine, Maddux and Smoltz
description: An in-depth interview with Atlanta Braves legends and Hall of Famers Greg Maddux, Tom Glavine and John Smoltz.

title: Celebrating '95
description: October 14: Steve Avery throws six scoreless innings and series MVP Mike Devereaux caps a five-run seventh with a three-run homer as the Braves shut out Cincinnati 6-0, complete the sweep and win their third pennant in five years.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
April 15
April 15: Ronald Acuña Jr.'s two-run homer stakes the Braves to a lead, Miami ties it in the ninth, and Dansby Swanson answers with a walk-off single to bring Acuña home. Atlanta wins 7-6 and snaps the Marlins' four-game win streak.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
May 19
May 19: One pitch is all it takes. Ronald Acuña Jr. leads off the bottom of the ninth with a walk-off home run to beat the Mets 5-4, backing six strong innings and eight strikeouts from Charlie Morton at Truist Park.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
June 30
June 30: The most lopsided win in the history of the Braves-Mets rivalry. Ozzie Albies posts career highs with five hits, two homers and seven RBIs, all nine Atlanta starters score, and the Braves pile up 20 hits in a 20-2 rout.

title: Celebrating '95
description: July 8: Eight wins in a row and the NL East lead grows to 3 1/2 games. Steve Avery takes the decision as Atlanta beats San Francisco 9-4 in front of 49,056 at Fulton County Stadium during the club's longest streak of 1995.

title: Celebrating '95
description: October 28: Tom Glavine allows one hit over eight innings, David Justice homers in the sixth for the game's only run and Mark Wohlers closes it out. The Braves beat Cleveland 1-0 for Atlanta's first World Series title.
